interpretation: Finite controls only. Actual satisfiable/unsatisfiable contexts must agree; raw conflict counts are not minimized. The solver makes no speculative decisions or backtracks. Pairwise support is not a completeness proof.

metric_definitions.color_prunes: maximum cumulative stats.prunes before the first eliminate event
metric_definitions.conflict_eliminations: successful eliminations before the first conflict; null for satisfiable cases
metric_definitions.domain_candidates: last reduction-domain snapshot before the first eliminate event
metric_definitions.intersection_row_prunes: sum of both tables' deletions in depth-zero intersection events
metric_definitions.row_prunes: all factor-row deletions before the first eliminate event

reference_method: exhaustive literal complete assignments against original edges and fixed colors
unsatisfiable_preservation: No original solutions exist; preservation checks are vacuous for these contexts.
